findings: 1. CRITICAL - Test infrastructure broken: 72 test failures + 26 errors out of 283 tests. Root cause: DeviceProvisioning table exists but no endpoint to create records; tests attempt to create EnrollmentToken records instead.

2. CRITICAL - Bootstrap endpoint cannot validate tokens: _consume_provisioning_token() looks for DeviceProvisioning.bootstrap_token_hash but tests only create EnrollmentToken records with token_hash. Schema mismatch.

3. CRITICAL - Admin provisioning endpoint missing: FEAT-002 spec calls for POST /device-provisioning/create endpoint but enrollment_routes.py only shows request/response models without endpoint implementation.
4. HIGH - DeviceIdentity table creation: 19 test failures indicate table exists but tests cannot access it. Likely database session or fixture initialization issue in test conftest.
5. HIGH - Architectural drift: Bootstrap flow designed around DeviceProvisioning records but implementation uses EnrollmentToken in legacy code. Two parallel token systems need reconciliation.

6. MEDIUM - FEAT-005 admin pages incomplete: Pages created (provisioning/page.tsx, devices/page.tsx, enrollment-policies/page.tsx) but backend API endpoints they depend on (POST /device-provisioning/create, GET /enrollment-policies, etc) either not implemented or not tested.

7. MEDIUM - Android managed config not integrated: ManagedConfigHelper.kt and ManagedConfigData.kt created (FEAT-004) but no evidence of integration into EnrollmentActivity startup path or tested in context.
8. MEDIUM - Regression test failures: 33 tests in test_device_routes_regression.py failing, indicating existing device enrollment flows may be broken by new enrollment system changes.

9. LOW - Attestation validation stubbed: _validate_attestation() returns true for all platforms with 'stub implementation' comments. Android SafetyNet, iOS DeviceCheck, Windows TPM verification not implemented (acceptable for v1 if documented).
summary: All 6 features architecturally complete but implementation has critical infrastructure failures preventing verification. Test suite broken (72 failures, 26 errors): DeviceProvisioning records cannot be created for bootstrap tests, device identity table access failing, and provisioning admin endpoint missing. Bootstrap token validation fails in all test scenarios due to schema mismatch (tests create EnrollmentToken, endpoint expects DeviceProvisioning). Existing device enrollment regression tests also failing. FEAT-003 (Android NPE fixes) verified working. FEAT-004 (managed config) code present but integration untested. FEAT-005 admin UI pages created but depend on incomplete backend APIs. Recommend: (1) Implement POST /device-provisioning/create endpoint, (2) Fix test fixtures to create DeviceProvisioning records, (3) Resolve DeviceIdentity table access errors, (4) Verify device enrollment regression tests pass.
